# sutramx_status_page (Resource)

A public status page showing the state of selected monitors. Counts against the plan's status page limit. Custom domains are set up in the dashboard by the workspace owner.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sutramx_status_page" "public" {
  title               = "Example status"
  slug                = "example-status"
  description         = "Live status of Example's website and API."
  is_public           = true
  show_response_times = true
  accent_color        = "#0d9488"

  monitors = [
    { monitor_id = sutramx_monitor.website.id },
    { monitor_id = sutramx_monitor.postgres.id, section = "Infrastructure" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Page title, 1-255 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace (SutramX trims it).

### Optional

- `accent_color` (String) Hex colour like `#0d9488`.
- `description` (String) Up to 1000 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace (SutramX trims it and stores an empty description as none, so leave the attribute out instead).
- `hide_powered_by` (Boolean) Remove SutramX branding (plans with white-label status pages).
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the page is published.
- `logo_url` (String) https:// image URL.
- `monitors` (Attributes List) Monitors shown on the page, in display order. Omit to manage them in the dashboard (the attribute then shows the current list). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitors))
- `show_response_times` (Boolean)
- `slug` (String) URL slug (lower-case letters, digits, hyphens). Generated from the title when not set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitors`

Required:

- `monitor_id` (String) `sutramx_monitor.<name>.id`

Optional:

- `section` (String) Optional heading the monitor is grouped under, 1-100 characters without leading or trailing whitespace.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sutramx_status_page.public 0b6f1c2a-9e4d-4f7a-8c3b-2d1e0f9a8b7c
```
